§lBedrock Edition§r

 §1Controls§r 

Every control in one place. New here? Read the Getting Started book next to this one first.

 §4§lBattling§r

Use (right-click) a wild Pokemon with an empty hand to battle it.

Pick Fight, Switch, Catch or Run.

Closing the battle screen minimises it. Sneak to bring it back.

 §4§lCatching§r

Choose Catch, then throw a Poke Ball at the wild Pokemon.

Weaken it and put it to sleep or paralyse it first for a better chance.

A ball in hand is always thrown.

 §4§lMedicine§r

Use a Potion, Revive or status cure on your own Pokemon to heal it.

In battle, minimise the battle screen, then use the medicine on the Pokemon fighting. It takes your turn.

 §4§lYour Pokemon§r

Sneak and use one of your Pokemon for its wheel: Summary, held item, cosmetic item, Ride, Shoulder, Stay and Follow.

Sneak twice to reopen the last Summary.

 §4§lItems on Pokemon§r

Use these on your own Pokemon:
Held items and berries to give them.
Evolution stones to evolve.
TMs to teach a move.
Candies to gain levels.

 §4§lRiding§r

Use a rideable Pokemon to get on. Sneak to get off.

On land, W walks, double-tap W sprints and holding jump jumps.

The bar over your hotbar is stamina.

 §4§lFlying§r

A flying Pokemon goes where you look.

Hold jump to climb. Look down while moving forward to dive and land.

When its stamina runs out it falls until it lands.

 §4§lOther Players§r

Sneak and use another player for their wheel.

Battle (top) sends a challenge.
Trade (top right) sends a trade request.

They answer from their own wheel on you.

 §4§lPokedex§r

Tap use to open your Pokedex.

Hold use to open the scanner. Keep a Pokemon in its sights to scan it.

While scanning, jump zooms in and sneak zooms out.

 §4§lFishing§r

Use a Poke Rod to cast into water.

When the bobber splashes, use it again quickly to reel in a Pokemon or an item.

Make rods at a smithing table.

 §4§lPC and Pasture§r

Use a PC to see your boxes. Choose a Pokemon, then the slot to move it to.

Use a Pasture, choose a boxed Pokemon, then a row to let it roam there.

 §4§lMachines§r

Healing Machine: use it to heal every Pokemon within 12 blocks.

TM Machine: pick a TM, then Start. It takes a Blank TM and the recipe items.

 §4§lCooking§r

Use a Campfire Pot on a lit campfire, then use the campfire to open it.

Fill the grid with a recipe, add seasonings, and press the lid button to cook.

 §4§lBerries, Apricorns§r

Plant a berry on grass or dirt. Use a ripe bush to pick its berries.

Use a ripe apricorn to pick it. Plant an Apricorn Sprout to grow a tree. Bone meal helps.

 §4§lFossils§r

Use a fossil on a Fossil Analyzer beside a Restoration Tank.

Feed the tank berries, wheat or bread. When it is done, use a Poke Ball on it to take your Pokemon.
